title: The Ramparts of Ice
description: Weighed down by memories she can’t shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm’s length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After her classmates run off in fear, Koyuki makes faces in a mirror to figure out why everyone finds her scary. Suddenly, a boy sneaks up behind her.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: To Koyuki's relief, Yota comes to her rescue. After their initial study session, they grow more comfortable with each other — which unsettles Minato.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Bothered that Koyuki still has her guard up around him, Minato tries to make small talk. As Miki grows suspicious of his intentions, she confronts him.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: At Miki's prodding, Minato clarifies his interest in her best friend. An unexpected visitor triggers Koyuki's bad memories, leading to a harsh outburst.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Koyuki mulls over the tense exchange in the infirmary. After Yota clears the air, she tries to have an honest conversation with Minato for the first time.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: As winter break ends, the usually calm Minato begins to realize his feelings are changing. Miki notices how close Yota and Koyuki have become.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: After reflecting on her own loneliness and worrying that Yota is bottling everything up, Koyuki reaches out and asks about his true feelings.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Determined not to mess up high school, Miki has faked her persona since day one. But not being herself around her classmates starts to wear her down.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Minato realizes how Koyuki is always on his mind. Later, while hanging out at the new mall, the misunderstanding between the four friends deepens.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: A spring break trip to the amusement park brings the four friends closer. Back at school, Koyuki's surprised by a familiar face — and Minato takes notice.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Koyuki broods over her complicated past with Akine's sister, Manatsu, and what the first year might know. Meanwhile, Momoka sets her sights on Minato.

episodes_data.title: The Ramparts of Ice Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: As Koyuki slowly notices her new, surprising feelings towards Minato, first-year Momoka suddenly tries to cozy up to her — for reasons she can't grasp.
